mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with overcast skies at the Verona Public Library. The moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city recently updated its engineering services reports, which are reviewed by the City Council. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather feedback on new design concepts.

We have a busy schedule! Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event.

In our weekly look at police activity, on October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I first offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by once they open.
